messages:
maya: quick sync — saw canary fallback to v2-lite cause truncated streaming responses and customers got charged for the truncated suffix. Suspect accounting marks tokens on fallback finalization.
raj: can you paste logs / request ids?
maya: pasted below from router logs for req id `req_0x9b3`:
```
2024-11-02T12:11:12Z router INFO fallback to v2-lite for req_0x9b3
2024-11-02T12:11:12Z stream DEBUG partial_chunk len=512 seq=8
2024-11-02T12:11:12Z stream INFO client closed connection mid-stream
2024-11-02T12:11:12Z billing WARN provisional_charge created session=req_0x9b3 amount=0.0042
2024-11-02T12:11:13Z billing INFO finalize_charge session=req_0x9b3 amount=0.0042
```
oliver: hmm billing finalizes as soon as the fallback finishes, but there's a race with reconnects. If client reconnects we re-send suffix -> double-charge risk.
lin: console note — users saw an immediate confirmed charge and filed a ticket. They expected "pending" until final ack.
billing-bot: event:charge.created session=req_0x9b3 provisional=true
deploy-bot: canary: rolled v2-lite -> hostpool-3 (3/3) :rocket:
raj: propose: change ledger flow to keep provisional until we get a confirm ack from runtime, or until a short grace window expires. We saw reconnects within ~1.4s.
maya: agree. small variant: keep provisional, but emit an idempotency token on retry so we can dedupe finalizes when suffix replays.
oliver: adding idempotency is fine but runtime will need to persist recent session tokens per host — memory/eviction knob. Also watch latency impact if we wait for ack before showing anything in UI.
lin: UX compromise: show immediate "pending (provisional)" charge row in console with hover text explaining provisional vs confirmed and a spinner. If confirmed -> change to normal, else refund badge.
raj: telemetry: record `acct.provisional_created`, `acct.finalized`, `acct.dedupe_matched`, and `acct.refund_triggered` with `route` and `fallback` tags. We'll get counts and latency histograms.
oliver: I'll draft a Grafana panel: stacked provisional vs confirmed by route; add alert if provisional/confirmed ratio > 0.2 for 5m.
maya: implementation plan: (1) ledger: stall finalize until ack/grace, add idempotency token, (2) runtime: persist recent session tokens w/ TTL 10s, (3) console: provisional UI state, (4) telemetry + dashboard.
lin: canary plan: enable on internal orgs first, then 10% public, monitor provisional ratio and customer tickets.
raj: one more edge: toolcalls. Tool responses may cause long tail tokens; if tool times out and runtime truncates, we need same provisional flow — we currently treat toolcall-generated tokens as final.
maya: good catch. include toolcall path in tests. Also add e2e that simulates reconnect during model swap.
oliver: I'll open PR for dashboard + telemetry. raj, can you own the ledger change? maya + lin can pair on console copy.
raj: yup. I'll add `acct.debug_session=true` flag for testing so we log prov/final events verbosely.
lin: can we bubble this into the rollout notes? I can draft the console copy and docs blurb.
maya: thanks all. going to spin up a small patch and drop a link here when PRs exist.
oliver: thanks — tagging @oncall for visibility :eyes:
maya: @oliver thanks. :thumbsup:
